1. TDA rules apply to all Venetian Poker Room tournaments. 
2. Must be 21+ years of age and have a Venetian Rewards card to participate. 
3. Each starting flight will play until we are down to approximately 12.5% of the 
field remaining. Day 2 will resume at 11:00 AM combining all remaining 
players from 1A and 1B with all players being considered in the money and will 
continue until a winner has been declared. To begin Day 2, the clock will revert 
to the earliest stoppage time of Day 1. 
4. Management reserves the right to cancel or change the tournament. 
5. Winners may choose to be paid in casino chips or cash. 
6. Winners must show a valid ID to collect winnings. Residents of foreign 
countries without a U.S. tax treaty will be subject to withholding. Pursuant to 
IRS regulations, W-2G or 1042 forms will be issued for all tournament 
winnings of $5,000 or more (net of buy-in amount). 
7. $70 of the $400 Buy-In is withheld for house fees (Rake + Staff). The prize 
pool consists of $330 of every $400 Buy In. 
8. Any player who bags chips for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight. 
9. Ante will come from the Big Blind Only. Big Blind is posted before the Ante. 
10. All pre-registered stacks will be in play at the start of the event. 
11. The tournament prize pool disbursement, as set forth herein, may be modified 
upon unanimous written agreement of management and of all tournament 
players still involved in the tournament. 
12. On Day 2, at Tournament Directors Discretion, players will have twenty (20) 
seconds pre-flop and thirty (30) seconds post-flop to act on their hand through 
the use of a countdown clock. Based on Day 2 field size, players will receive 
the following time-extension chips, each worth a 30-second addition to a 
player's action: 
a. Less than 46 players: 5-time extension chips. 
b. 46-72 players: 3-time extension chips + 3 at 27 players remaining. 
c. 73-99 players: 4-time extension chips + 3 at 27 players remaining. 
d. 100 + players: 5-time extension chips + 3 at 27 players remaining. 
13. In the case that time expires for a player with remaining time-extension chips, 
the player's countdown clock will automatically extend an additional thirty (30) 
seconds. Collection of time-extension chips will take place at the end of the 
player's action. If a player's countdown clock expires and the player does not 
have any time-extension chips remaining, they will be (a) forced to check, if 
there is no bet pending or (b) fold, if facing a bet or raise. Shot Clocks will be 
removed at the Final Table.
